mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past quarter signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 signals strong labor demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant positive (p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS exceeding 130,000, or the increase is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust economic growth, enhancing corporate profit margins and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and concurrent decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable dual signal for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), persistent increases in the federal funds rate signal higher policy rates, compressing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising, or the tightening effect is not consistently observed across multiple cycles (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) alongside rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a conflicting but stabilizing signal for risk assets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: improving labor market with tightening policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the dual signal, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, amplifying corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or the combined effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 7.5% triggers concerns about overheating labor markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 7.5%, or the decline is not sustained beyond the trigger period.
